title: ICP Definition Builder
one_line: Turn a description of a business into a structured ideal customer profile with firmographic criteria, signals, pain indicators and exclusion rules.
description: Turn a description of a business into a structured ideal customer profile with firmographic criteria, signals, pain indicators and exclusion rules. Use when someone asks who to sell to, wants to define their ICP, build targeting criteria, or segment a market.
paragraph: Most ICP documents are a list of adjectives that no filter can apply. This skill produces a profile whose every line is either a filter you can run or a signal you can detect, plus the exclusion rules that matter more than the inclusion rules, because exclusions are what keep a list clean.
